items.title: File Klage against the operating-hours order at the Verwaltungsgericht
items.quote: Innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe kann gegen diesen Bescheid Klage beim Verwaltungsgericht Musterarnsberg, Jägerstraße 1, 59821 Musterarnsberg, erhoben werden.
items.computation: The letter is dated Thursday 19.11.2026; as a letter from an administrative authority sent by ordinary post, it counts as delivered (Bekanntgabe, § 41 Abs. 2 VwVfG) on the 4th day after posting, i.e. Monday 23.11.2026 (no weekend shift applies to this delivery rule). The one-month Klage period (§ 74 VwGO) then starts counting the next day under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB, i.e. from 23.11.2026, and ends one month later under § 188 Abs. 2 BGB on 23.12.2026, a Wednesday that is a normal working day in NRW, so no further shift is needed.

warnings: The letter refers to an underlying "Bescheid vom 18.11.2026" but the letter itself (which contains the Rechtsbehelfsbelehrung) is dated 19.11.2026; the Klage deadline above is calculated from the letter's own date (19.11.2026) as the posting day — if the Bescheid of 18.11.2026 was actually sent/received separately and earlier, the one-month period could run out one day sooner, so check the envelope or any separate cover letter for the real posting date.

Deemed delivery (4 days after posting) was assumed because the letter does not state it was formally served (no yellow envelope / Postzustellungsurkunde mentioned); if it was served that way, the period runs from the date on the service document instead, which could be earlier.
Filing a Klage is a formal court action that Ordnung cannot draft or submit — get advice from a lawyer or a Verbraucherzentrale well before the computed deadline.
